SK9006 A setting is on that Skala cannot honour

One of skala_autodetect_indent_settings, skala_apply_auto_detected_rules, skala_use_indent_from_vs, skala_old_engine or skala_use_old_engine is set to true. Skala has no such mode, so the IDE and the gate would format the same file differently. Set it to false.

CategoryTool
Default severitywarning
ScopeCompilation
Needs a compilationno
Runs under --load=looseno
Cached per fileno — it reads the whole compilation
Fixno
Language version floor—
Since0.1

Why

The first three tell Rider to format against an indent it detects from the file rather than the configured one. Skala has no detector to switch off, so it formats against the configuration while Rider formats against whatever it inferred, and the two disagree on exactly the files where the inference differs (docs/plan/16 § Q1). The last two select ReSharper's previous formatting engine, which Skala does not reproduce. Neither is a fault in the code, which is why it is a warning about the configuration and not a finding against a file.

Example

Instead of:

skala_autodetect_indent_settings = true

Write:

skala_autodetect_indent_settings = false

When it does not fire

Only a value of true or always is reported. The key set to false — the shipped template's state — is silent, and a test asserts that silence. Each key is checked independently, so up to five can fire from one file.
